paragraphs: I am an undergraduate mechanical engineering student with hands-on experience in CAD/CAE, structural FEA, and system-level vehicle design.
My work spans IIT Roorkee research internship, BAJA SAE suspension engineering, and multi-disciplinary fabrication projects, each validated with measurable real-world results.

points: Designed and fabricated an assistive page reading technology for visually impaired users.
Designed a custom mechanism for Braille display in SolidWorks for compact packaging and reliable haptic output.
Developed a Python-based graphical user interface supporting digital document upload, automated text parsing, and real-time serial communication with hardware.

Programmed an Arduino microcontroller to interpret incoming digital text streams and drive stepper motors, accurately translating document data into synchronized rotational movements for haptic reading.

projects.title: Suspension, BAJA SAE
projects.summary: Off-road suspension designed for fatigue resistance under harsh terrain loads.
details: Defined suspension geometry and hardpoints, validating structural integrity with FEA and multi-body dynamics simulations.
Optimized load paths to reduce unsprung mass by 12% while preserving 100% structural reliability.
